page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, delivering 32 virtual CPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It has no local NVMe or SSD storage bundled, requiring network-attached block storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is rated at a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core processing, evaluated via stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the lower 25% tier, with single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by a Passmark CPU score of 23,223.67 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 108.79 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the middle 50% tier, reaching 96.24 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 48.07 GB/sec for writes.

Given its hardware profile, the instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that benefit from high resource density and parallel execution rather than raw single-threaded speed. It supports advanced vector extensions including AVX-512 and VNNI, which assist in vector calculations and basic machine learning tasks. Benchmark results show average performance for Redis SET operations at 22.63 million operations per second and static web serving at 17.15 GB/sec. This makes the instance suitable for multi-threaded applications, database operations, web serving, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
